sources.note: arXiv:2609.25938v1. Design, discussion and limitations read. Oracle swap raises held-out risk 2.73-10.23 points; own-oracle scores look better in 16/16. One benchmark family. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.24200v1. Sections 3.3-3.5 and 4 read. Forgeability follows whether the decision reads attacker-controlled data; anchoring off that channel took attack success 97% to 0%. Offline security pipeline. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.20758v1. Sections 2, 3.1 and 5 read. A simulated non-probability sample keeps bias as budget grows and PPI does not fix it. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.26384v1. Full methods read. Frozen predictor, trained rejector, guidance as a third action; classic two-stage L2D did not beat baselines on 324-image Collab-CXR. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.12742v1. Full methods read. Only paired candidate-versus-seed runs were informative; best sign test p=0.29; grading the document is a bad proxy. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.22512v1. Abstract and appendix formula read. Mean judge-error correlation 0.21 makes 10 judges worth about 3.5 (recomputed 3.46). Already covered. Reported. notes.md §166.

sources.note: arXiv:2609.24574v1. Abstract, introduction and sections 4.4-4.5 read. Independent study: Jev trails the per-task best LLM on 14/15 tasks at much lower cost; cascade recovers LLM quality at a fraction of cost. Already covered. Reported. notes.md §166.
